env.#1: The IndexNow key, served at /<key>.txt. Generate one into .env.local: bin/console indexnow:key:generate --write-env
env.#2: Empty outside production = dry run (nothing is sent); empty in production = a configuration error indexnow:check explains
env.#3: The public URL of the site (console commands and Messenger workers have no request to read it from)
